entries.backgroundDescription: Balcon extérieur de l’Observatoire Veyr entre deux arches de métal ancien. Dalles sombres gravées de lignes causales, petite marche et garde-corps bas en laiton patiné. Nova en posture analytique, manteau bleu nuit lisible et diapason U entier appuyé librement contre la balustrade à son côté. Tours de la Cité-Mosaïque, anneaux d’observation et ciel crépusculaire aux premières étoiles. Lumière bleue du crépuscule, touches d’or des lampes et faible lueur cyan de son équipement.

Interprétation masculine de Nova assise de façon asymétrique, mêmes cheveux argentés, monocle, manteau marine et diapason U. entries.backgroundDescription: Petite salle d’exercice de lecture causale de Veyr, portes ouvertes sur un jardin à l’aube. Marques géométriques simples au sol et dalle de test intacte, gants et bottes entièrement visibles. Nova à demi accroupie sur deux appuis pointe une marque au sol de la main libre, diapason U entier incliné dans l’autre main et manteau replié entier. Rangements sobres, trois petits anneaux de test et jardin silencieux au-delà du seuil. Aube claire et fraîche, lumière rasante sur les marques au sol et discret cyan du matériel.

visualLocks.hair: Short silver/grey asymmetric bob; longer fringe hides one eye. Never historical dark-haired male design.
visualLocks.face: Youth-neutral fair face as selected sprite; visible cyan reading monocle, anatomical side unresolved at this sprite resolution.
visualLocks.costume: Long split navy technical coat, closed black/navy bodysuit, dark chest and knee/shin plates, cyan seams, black gloves and boots. No helmet.
visualLocks.equipment: One long cyan-lit black/metal resonance staff ending in two parallel open U prongs; no rectangular screen-head staff from historical atlas, no rifle, no shield or card deck.
visualLocks.palette: Primary navy#153b55 and cyan#7df9ff, silver hair, black protective suit; modest copper/ivory environmental accents only.
visualLocks.anatomy: One human body/head, two arms/two legs, ordinary five-finger gloved hands where visible.
visualLocks.personality: Precise mobile possibility analyst. Measures causal routes without predicting certain futures or imposing her preferred choice.
visualLocks.distinction: Nova reads possibilities with monocle/diapason; she is not Mirelle with cards/sutures, Bastion with heavy shield/gun, or the player Anchor commander.

sourceLimitations: Canonical authority here is internal project material, not an independently sourced real-world franchise.
Source raster is887x1774 with4x8frames; microdetails and exact monocle side are not reliably resolvable.
A generic ARCA signal-lens item was viewed for context but is not established as Nova-specific equipment and will not replace her staff.
The dedicated character-arcWebP path exists in catalog metadata but its file is absent; it is not claimed viewed.
Historical4x4atlas has conflicting dark-haired terminal-staff design; it remains untouched and is not mixed with current pack.
Age is not documented; all15scenes are family-safe/non-romantic and no adult age or age regression is inferred.
Glove finger coverage varies in some CG; the selected small sprite cannot establish this costume microcut. Larger anatomy/proportions are interpreted rather than validated by an orthographic model.
